title: Acorn Mathematics save, version 2 (user://profile_<profile>.json)
description: One save per profile on the device, written after every task. Version 1 (no schema field, profile "1", one file user://profile_1.json) upgrades on read in SaveData.from_text. The server never reads inside it; the game merges snapshots on restore.

gems.description: Balance to spend. Equals the sum of earned minus the sum of spent in gem_counts.

gem_counts.description: dev -> {earned, spent}. Each device only raises its own counts, so a merge takes each device's highest counts and the totals come out exact.

marks.description: area or world id -> level ids beaten.

stars.description: world id -> level ids cleared without losing a heart.

book.description: The monster book (Phase 6): monster or miniboss id -> Level numbers (1 to 6) it was beaten at. Optional; a merge unions it like marks.

run.description: The level in progress. Stays on its device: never merged.

parent_open.description: Worlds a grown-up opened on the tablet. Phase 1 removes the switches; kept so old saves still read.

taught.description: Ellwynn's taught first turn: cue id (T1, N3 ...) -> true once this child has heard it.
